entities.name: Wool from Sheep
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Early domesticated sheep had hair, not wool. Selective breeding over millennia created woolly sheep. Wool's insulating properties — warm when wet, naturally fire-resistant — made it the ideal fiber for Northern European climates.
